title: tragus major
intro: Tragus major, commonly known as the Tragacanth or Tragacanth gum, is a type of flowering plant in the legume family. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as wounds, skin irritations, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Tragus major include soothing and protecting the mucous membranes, as well as providing a protective barrier against infections. The bioactive constituents of Tragus major include tragacanth, a complex mixture of polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
